'''Sulara Hold''' is an [[Aiel]] [[hold|settlement]] in the [[Aiel Waste|Three-fold Land]]. [[Niella]], [[first-sister]] to [[Aviendha]], is from Sulara Hold. She was taken ''[[gai'shain]]'' by ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' of the [[Chareen]] [[clan]] during a raid.{{ref/book|5|32}} It is unknown if the hold is held by the [[Taardad]] or if ownership changed during the raid.
